# PARROT item set (third-party data)

`mmlu-mixed-10each-seed42.jsonl` is PARROT's evaluation set, unchanged: 130
MMLU questions, ten from each of 13 subjects, from
<https://github.com/YusufCelebii/PARROT> at commit
`a5a09a3769bd4195654ccff6cd689775f24ef542` (SHA-256
`98f1395f193d2c694ed88212f50c633a8654b6644a5d950dbf0acc45279e3852`).
PARROT is "Persuasion and Agreement Robustness Rating of Output Truth"
(Çelebi, arXiv:2511.17220). The questions come from MMLU (Hendrycks et al.,
ICLR 2021).

Licence: MIT; the licence text is in `LICENSE` beside this file. No changes
were made. It is used only by `scripts/transfer_more.py`, an exploratory check
added after MAIN.
